evidence: craft-libs licence now recorded: MIT OR Apache-2.0; both pinned revisions vendored into apps/cadcraft/vendor/ with PROVENANCE.md and sha256 manifests (no GitHub needed for release builds).
SolidCraft still vendors four patched truck crates plus two UI crates with [patch.crates-io]; the fork must be tracked deliberately.

findings.title: The agent runtime is in-process and unscheduled
findings.action: Isolate third-party agents in a separate process before any are loaded, and move agent execution off the UI thread. The first-party agent is reviewed with the repository and is not exposed to untrusted code.
